reporting_policy: Every user-facing project progress output should report at minimum requirements_structure_percent, g1_system_freeze_percent and backlog_done_percent. Broader engineering percentages must be explicitly labeled estimates.

requirements_structure.meaning: Planned requirement-domain hierarchy/schema/authority coverage, not product-value closure.

g1_system_freeze.note: PB-04 freezes the nominal 10-minute mission target, 10-minute hover-equivalent energy-sizing target and >=20% sizing reserve, and corrects controller capability to >=90 keRPM. PASS means controlled value closure/traceability, not physical verification.

backlog.note: Conservative metric: only tasks explicitly marked DONE are counted. S1.2 and S1.3 have advanced, but UAV-005/UAV-006 remain IN_PROGRESS until exact pack sag/min-bus and PWM/protection/thermal parents close.

gate_closure.note: G0/G1 remain OPEN because mass allocation, environment, exact pack sag/minimum bus, PWM, protection and thermal requirements remain unresolved. G2-G7 remain dependency-blocked.
